title: Comparison test for nonnegative real series
statement: Let $u,v:\mathbf N\to\mathbf R$ be coefficient sequences of formal series $\sum_{n\ge0}u_nT^n$ and $\sum_{n\ge0}v_nT^n$ in the series conventions of [d-real-series]. If $0\le u_n\le v_n$ for every $n\ge0$ and $\sum_{n\ge0}v_n$ is summable, then $\sum_{n\ge0}u_n$ is summable. Here summability means convergence of the net of sums over finite subsets of $\mathbf N$.
